title: FAILSPAN: Structural Mayhem
one_line: Build real-physics bridges in 2D or 3D, from Class 8 to Expert Engineer: answer your class's questions to earn parts, then test the bridge with traffic. Build. Stress. Snap.
how_to_play: Pick your class, tap its building, answer questions to earn parts, tap two joints to place a member, then press Test bridge. Guide, Hint and Show me lead you step by step; Forces shows the pushes and pulls at any joint.
description: Nine buildings on one road: Class 8 to 12, BE, NIT, IIT and Expert Engineer. Each building has only its own question bank (16,000+ quality questions, no look-alikes: physics, chemistry, maths, geography, economics, commerce, accountancy, computer, engineering, a bridge quiz for every project and a ⚡ Edge tab of hard questions from the class's whole syllabus) and its own bridge to build, one bridge project per class from a cable bridge for Class 8 to a two-pylon convoy bridge for Class 12, and the convoy bridge again for BE, NIT, IIT and Expert. A real stiffness-method truss solver checks every member for snapping, crushing and buckling as the vehicle drives across, and force arrows show the physics at any joint. English and Bengali, guided steps, hints, stars, unlocks, badges, a daily streak, a weekly bridge challenge and a printable report card for teachers. Play in 2D or 3D: the 3D view puts your bridge over a sunset canyon, drives real 3D vehicles across with a live stress meter, and shows every snap with sparks, debris and slow motion. Works offline once loaded.
